create.name: Miami Life Center
create.bio:
Miami Life Center is an Ashtanga Yoga shala founded by the married teachers Kino MacGregor and Tim Feldmann, both of whom trained in Mysore under K. Pattabhi Jois and later R. Sharath Jois, and hold certification from that lineage. The school traces its home in the city to a South Beach shala that opened in 2006; since 2020 its main rooms have been in the Wynwood and Overtown area, at a space it calls the Miami Yoga Garage. Its resident Mysore teachers, among them the directors Joseph Armstrong and Edgar Navarro, came up through a two-year apprenticeship at the centre, practising daily, assisting classes and reading yogic texts before taking students of their own.

The heart of the timetable is self-paced Mysore practice, alongside led classes, vinyasa sessions and observance of moon days, with some classes also streamed online. Twice a year Kino and Tim run a Mysore season of morning practice, chanting and afternoon workshops on the method and its roots. Each autumn a month-long intensive, meeting Yoga Alliance's 200-hour standard, covers the Primary Series, Sanskrit vinyasa counting, breathing practice and Patanjali's Yoga Sutras. Shorter trainings and visiting-teacher workshops fill the rest of the year.

courses.title: Ashtanga Intensive with Joseph Armstrong and Edgar Navarro
courses.description: A month of daily Mysore practice and study at the shala, led by its two directors and resident faculty. Sessions cover the Primary Series, breathing practice, Sanskrit vinyasa counting, chanting and the Yoga Sutras, and the course meets Yoga Alliance's 200-hour standard.
courses.price: Regular Tuition: $2,700 (Early Bird Tuition: $2,250, available through February 2, 2027)

courses.title: January 2027 Miami Mysore Season with Kino and Tim
courses.description: One to three weeks of morning Mysore-style practice with Kino MacGregor and Tim Feldmann, a led Primary Series each Saturday, and optional afternoon workshops on asana and the Ashtanga method. Open to students of any level who already know the Mysore format.
courses.price: 1 week of Mysore Style + Led Primary on Saturday: $400 MLC Members | $450 Non-members

courses.title: Summer 2027 Miami Mysore Season with Kino and Tim
courses.description: Up to four weeks of morning practice with the founders, with chanting and Puranas sessions and a different afternoon theme each week, from the roots of vinyasa krama to an assisting school. Students can join for a single week or the full programme.

courses.title: All Access Membership (Plus Mysore)
courses.description: A monthly auto-renewing pass to the studio's timetable, including the Mysore programme. Class passes and online-only options are also listed on the same page.
